reasoning: 驗證目標：HU 顯示清單時，允許逐頁捲動。為什麼這樣切：本條款述的是能力且不限觸發方式，故以兩種不同型態的清單各測一次，證明該能力屬於「清單顯示」而非某一畫面的特例；140 則綁定 Page Up/Down 觸發路徑與一頁的位移量（A-SX20）。

tcs.tc_title: Page-by-page scrolling is available on any displayed list
tcs.test_item: While the HU is displaying a List, the HU shall allow page-by-page scrolling of the list
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. Two lists of different kinds are reachable, each longer than two screens, for example the all-channel list and the favorites list
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Display the first list and scroll it by one page
2. Read the entries shown
3. Display the second list and scroll it by one page
4. Read the entries shown
tcs.expected_result:
1. Scrolling by one page is offered and accepted
2. A page of entries that were not previously shown is displayed
3. Scrolling by one page is offered and accepted
4. A page of entries that were not previously shown is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
